0.name: TEXT_CTSDDD2REWARD_00826_DD2SHOP_000_000
0.description: Staring out at the Ruby Sea is all well and good, but being forced to stand here on guard duty is a whole different kettle of fish.

1.name: TEXT_CTSDDD2REWARD_00826_DD2SHOP_000_010
1.description: Bring something back from the tower, did you?

2.name: TEXT_CTSDDD2REWARD_00826_DD2SHOP_000_020
2.description: So, have you got anything we might be interested in?

5.name: TEXT_CTSDDD2REWARD_00826_START_SHOP2
5.description: Request to keep your aetherpool gear.

9.name: TEXT_CTSDDD2REWARD_00826_DD2SHOP_000_030
9.description: Why don't you come back once you've finished exploring floor thirty? Hopefully I'll be in more of a position to help you by then.

10.name: TEXT_CTSDDD2REWARD_00826_SYSTEM_000_031
10.description: You must first clear floor 30 and complete the subsequent quest in order to use aetherpool gear outside of Heaven<hex:021F0103>on<hex:021F0103>High.

11.name: TEXT_CTSDDD2REWARD_00826_DD2SHOP_000_100
11.description: The weapon you've been wielding in the tower has grown to be rather powerful. I can siphon off some of that aether and make an empyrean aetherpool grip if you like.

12.name: TEXT_CTSDDD2REWARD_00826_TEST_EXCHANGE_MENU_TITLE
12.description: Forge an empyrean aetherpool grip?<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>※The strength of your empyrean aetherpool arm and armor will be reduced by 10.<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>

13.name: TEXT_CTSDDD2REWARD_00826_DD2SHOP_100_110
13.description: You want to forge grips so you can take your empyrean aetherpool gear out of Heaven<hex:021F0103>on<hex:021F0103>High? Not to piss on your bonfire, but it sounds like you've still got some unfinished business in there. You'd better concentrate on that before we start drawing the aether out of your equipment.

14.name: TEXT_CTSDDD2REWARD_00826_SYSTEM_100_111
14.description: You must first clear floor 30 and complete the subsequent quest in order to forge empyrean aetherpool grips.

15.name: TEXT_CTSDDD2REWARD_00826_DD2SHOP_000_110
15.description: I'm afraid you haven't accumulated enough aether for that. You'll need to get back into the tower and let it build up a bit more. Mind you, standing around twiddling your thumbs won't do much! Open as many coffers as you can, especially the silver ones.

16.name: TEXT_CTSDDD2REWARD_00826_SYSTEM_000_111
16.description: In order to forge an empyrean aetherpool grip, both your empyrean aetherpool weapon and armor must have attained a minimum strength of +10.

18.name: TEXT_CTSDDD2REWARD_00826_START_ABOUT_TOKEN
18.description: What is there to be found in the tower?

19.name: TEXT_CTSDDD2REWARD_00826_START_ABOUT
19.description: Can aetherpool arms be used outside of the tower?

21.name: TEXT_CTSDDD2REWARD_00826_DD2SHOP_000_150
21.description: If you find any empyrean potsherds, bring them to me. They might not look like much, but I'd be willing to trade for them.

22.name: TEXT_CTSDDD2REWARD_00826_DD2SHOP_000_151
22.description: I've got quite a fine selection of wares to choose from, materia mostly, so take your pick. And let me tell you─I'm the only one around who understands the true value of those magick-imbued shards. You'll struggle to even give them away elsewhere!

23.name: TEXT_CTSDDD2REWARD_00826_DD2SHOP_000_160
23.description: While Heaven<hex:021F0103>on<hex:021F0103>High might be crawling with fiends, it's not all bad news. You know about the empyrean aetherpool gear, and I expect you've seen pomanders and magicite. Well, it's not actually magicite as such, but some dunderhead decided to call it that and the name stuck.

24.name: TEXT_CTSDDD2REWARD_00826_DD2SHOP_000_161
24.description: Anyway, where was I? Ah, empyrean potsherds! Although they won't help you while you're in the tower, I'll take them off of your hands in exchange for some of my wares. How does that sound?

25.name: TEXT_CTSDDD2REWARD_00826_DD2SHOP_000_200
25.description: Taking your empyrean aetherpool weapon outside the tower? Hmmm... I'll need more time to perfect the process, I'm afraid.

26.name: TEXT_CTSDDD2REWARD_00826_DD2SHOP_000_201
26.description: Why don't you come back once you've finished exploring floor thirty? Hopefully I'll be in more of a position to help you by then.

27.name: TEXT_CTSDDD2REWARD_00826_DD2SHOP_100_200
27.description: Now that you know our true identities, I can show you the secret techniques of the Onishishu. First, I'll need to extract some of the aether from your empyrean aetherpool gear to make the necessary grips.

28.name: TEXT_CTSDDD2REWARD_00826_DD2SHOP_100_201
28.description: When you have enough grips, give them to me and I'll work my magicks, so to speak, to allow you to use the weapon outside of the tower.

29.name: TEXT_CTSDDD2REWARD_00826_SYSTEM_000_203
29.description: To use your empyrean aetherpool weapon outside of Heaven<hex:021F0103>on<hex:021F0103>High, you must first forge empyrean aetherpool grips.

30.name: TEXT_CTSDDD2REWARD_00826_SYSTEM_000_204
30.description: Forging one grip will reduce the strength of your empyrean aetherpool arm and armor by 10.

31.name: TEXT_CTSDDD2REWARD_00826_SYSTEM_000_205
31.description: You must first clear floor 30 of Heaven<hex:021F0103>on<hex:021F0103>High and complete the subsequent quest in order to forge an empyrean aetherpool grip.
